citation: 'Lost Houses of Prairie Avenue: 1800-1900 Blocks (East Side)', Prairie Avenue Historic District interpretive marker, Chicago; transcription on the Historical Marker Database (HMdb), marker 308709.
locator: The transcription page's photograph captions and the 1815 S. Prairie Ave. entry.
rights_note: A modern interpretive marker's text, cited in words only; nothing is copied into the scene.
access_notes: Read 2026-10-17 (T-2747) through a page fetch that returned only part of the transcription: no name lines for the first entries, one photograph caption, and the 1815 entry. This record is cited for those parts only. The Prairie library's 2026-09-26 reading of the same page (marker_east) records architects and dates for 1815, 1823, 1827, 1901 and 1905 that were NOT re-read here, and nothing in 4D rests on them through this record. Re-read 2026-11-07 (demolition notes): that fetch returned the name and loss lines for 1815, 1823, 1827, 1901 and 1905, and this record is cited for them too.
note: Read: the photograph caption 'Marshall Field Sr. residence at 1905 S. Prairie'; and of 1815 S. Prairie Ave., 'The home was built by Joseph Sears, the founder of the Chicago suburb of Kenilworth.' Re-read 2026-11-07 through a page fetch that returned every entry's name line and loss line: 1815 Joseph Sears Residence, built 1882, Burnham & Root, 'Razed 1967'; 1823 Thomas Dent Residence, built 1881, Burnham & Root, 'Razed 1945'; 1827 John W. Doane Residence, built 1882, Theodore V. Wadskier, 'Razed 1936'; 1901 Osborn R. Keith-Norman B. Ream Residence, built 1882, Lavall B. Dixon, later offices for the Radford Architectural Company, 'Razed 1929'; 1905 Marshall Field Residence, built 1871-1873, Richard Morris Hunt, later converted to an aeronautical university, 'Razed 1955'. These agree with the Prairie library's 2026-09-26 reading.
what_it_supplies: Marshall Field Sr.'s house at 1905 S. Prairie
Joseph Sears as builder of 1815 S. Prairie
the year each house was razed, as the marker gives it
what_it_does_not_supply: architects or dates for the block's east side, which this reading did not return
